ciudadbots.home.title.message: Applied robotics and tech citizenship for Guatemala

ciudadbots.home.lead.message: A hub of educational programs for lower secondary: block-based robotics, Arduino robotics and programmable displays. Each program states the grade it targets and brings together its teaching sequence, resources, curriculum alignment and assessment in one place.

ciudadbots.home.ciudadbotsCardBody.message: 12 LEGO SPIKE robotics missions with city challenges: mapping, delivery, logistics, infrastructure, emergency response, and more. Includes a teacher guide, base programs, and rubrics.

guategeeks.home.smarsCardBody.message: 12 sessions building an autonomous tracked robot with plain Arduino: two motors, an ultrasonic sensor, and a state machine. Includes a teacher guide, five verified sketches, and a rubric. Material available in Spanish.

tiempocircular.home.segundoBadge.description: Badge on the Tiempo Circular card on the hub landing page

tiempocircular.home.cardBody.message: 12 sessions building a clock on a circular display with an ESP32. Trigonometry places the hands, colour is assembled bit by bit, and the final face counts the cycles of the Cholq'ij calendar. Available in Spanish.
tiempocircular.home.cardBody.description: Body text of the Tiempo Circular card on the hub landing page

platform.home.heroLead.message: A platform of pathways for discovering, building, and creating with robotics, programming, and digital fabrication in the classroom.

platform.home.hero.imageAlt.message: Students working in a GuateGeeks educational robotics platform.

platform.home.intro.title.message: From the first circuit to a presentable prototype

platform.home.intro.body.message: Each level groups experiences with a clear purpose: explore concepts, build systems, and create projects that can be communicated. Available cards open active Docusaurus routes; upcoming pathways stay visible without linking to missing pages.

platform.home.level.explorador.imageAlt.message: Students exploring circuits, sensors, and first robotics ideas.

platform.home.level.explorador.purpose.message: A first encounter with creative technology: circuits, robot storytelling, and augmented experiences for learning by doing before programming complex projects.

platform.home.level.constructor.imageAlt.message: Robotics classroom with students building robots and prototypes.

platform.home.level.constructor.purpose.message: Programs where the team turns ideas into machines: structure, sensors, code, testing, and iterative improvement connected to real challenges.

platform.home.level.creador.imageAlt.message: Students creating digital prototypes, displays, and interactive objects.

platform.home.level.creador.purpose.message: Pathways for building original artifacts: displays, wearables, creative AI, and digital fabrication with documentation, iteration, and public presentation.

platform.home.program.circuitos.imageAlt.message: Work table with lights, wires, and components for first circuits.

platform.home.program.circuitos.summary.message: Short challenges for understanding energy, inputs, and outputs while the team builds visible prototypes from the first session.

platform.home.program.talebot.imageAlt.message: Tale-Bot robot on an illustrated path for computational thinking.

platform.home.program.talebot.summary.message: Sequences, spatial orientation, and debugging without screens, with classroom-ready narrative missions.

platform.home.program.ar.imageAlt.message: Students observing an augmented scene on a learning table.

platform.home.program.ar.summary.message: Activities for blending physical objects, scientific observation, and digital layers that help explain phenomena.

platform.home.program.ciudadbots.imageAl.message: CiudadBots educational robot moving through a learning city.

platform.home.program.ciudadbots.summary.message: LEGO SPIKE robotics missions with urban challenges: mapping, delivery, logistics, infrastructure, emergency response, and communicating solutions.

platform.home.program.smars.imageAlt.message: SMARS tracked robot with Arduino components on a work table.

platform.home.program.smars.summary.message: Build an autonomous tracked robot with plain Arduino, two motors, an ultrasonic sensor, and a state machine.

platform.home.program.makerzoid.imageAlt.message: Makerzoid kit prepared for a rescue mission with modular pieces.

platform.home.program.makerzoid.summary.message: Rescue projects and fast mechanisms for working on strategy, mechanical design, and collaboration under constraints.

platform.home.program.vr.imageAlt.message: Students using virtual reality headsets to explore environments.

platform.home.program.vr.summary.message: Guided immersive experiences for investigating places, systems, and problems before designing a physical or digital solution.

platform.home.program.tiempoCircular.ima.message: Programmable circular display with a colorful clock face.

platform.home.program.tiempoCircular.sum.message: Program a clock on a circular display with ESP32: trigonometry, color, coordinates, and a face inspired by the cycles of the Cholq'ij calendar.

platform.home.program.wearables.imageAlt.message: Wearable prototype with lights and sensors sewn into fabric.

platform.home.program.wearables.summary.message: Wearable technology labs that combine soft electronics, measurement, and human-centered design.

platform.home.program.ia.imageAlt.message: Screen with a creative artificial intelligence interface for the classroom.

platform.home.program.ia.summary.message: Projects for using AI as material for creation, analysis, and communication while maintaining judgment, authorship, and human review.

platform.home.program.fab3d.summary.message: Design, fabricate, and test physical objects to solve concrete needs from the classroom, the community, or an engineering challenge.

ciudadbots.estudiante.roles.organizer.de.message: Keeps pieces organized, takes care of materials, and verifies the team completes each step calmly and clearly.

ciudadbots.estudiante.roles.programmer.d.message: When it's time, opens the base program, follows the team's instructions, and explains the robot's behavior.

ciudadbots.estudiante.lead.message: This guide lets you move step by step through building the robot with your team. Use the roles, discuss every decision, and rotate responsibilities so everyone tries a different way of working.

ciudadbots.estudiante.rolesNote.message: Suggestion: rotate roles every so many steps so everyone experiences a different responsibility.
